amendments.reason: Severities recalibrated against the frozen reference decoder (scripts/18 calibrate). The original levels were guesses; the design always said the numbers were an empirical question. Also fixes CHANNEL_DROPOUT to be nested across severities, and adds a 'benign' level per mode as hard negative cases. No detector has been run against any plan.

GAIN_DRIFT rescaled to preserve the arithmetic mean exactly (it previously raised mean activity +116% at crossing severity, defeating its purpose). Severities unchanged; calibration reconfirmed after the fix. Still no detector has been run against any plan.

GAIN_DRIFT normalisation changed again, to exact per-bin conservation of total activity (was: pre-onset channel profile, which left +20.8% because the block's own activity drifts within a block). Also: pre-onset rows are now restored exactly for every mode, so the 'nothing changes before onset' guarantee holds by construction rather than by rounding. Episodes are unchanged; severities reconfirmed by calibration after the fix. No detector has been run against any plan.

note: Onsets in this file were drawn BEFORE any detector was run against them. They must not be changed. To change them, re-run `plan --amend REASON`, which preserves this record and appends the reason.
